about.heading: Student. Teammate. Future meteorologist.
about.body:
Kevin Franz Jr. is a 6'1", 190 lb SG/SF in the Class of 2028 at Shawnee Mission West in Overland Park, Kansas. He plays club basketball with JC Hoops 16U, wearing #28.

GPA is 3.75 unweighted and 3.82 weighted through 10th grade at Blue Valley Southwest. He is in the JCCC dual degree program and will graduate with an associate degree and his high school diploma. He is taking only one class at Shawnee Mission West.
